all_scopes_completion.description: Include index symbols not defined in visible scopes for code completion.

background_index.description: Index project code in the background and persist index on disk.

background_index_priority.description: Thread priority for background index: background, low, or normal.

compile_commands_dir.description: Path to look for compile_commands.json. If empty, clangd searches current directory and parent paths.

completion_style.description: Granularity of code completion: detailed or bundled.

enable_config.description: Enable reading user and project configuration from YAML files.

experimental_modules_support.description: Enable experimental support for C++ modules.

fallback_style.description: clang-format style to apply by default when .clang-format is missing.

function_arg_placeholders.description: Include placeholders for function parameters in completions.

header_insertion.description: Include directive insertion policy: iwyu or never.

header_insertion_decorators.description: Prepend circular dot/space to indicate include insertion in completions.

import_insertions.description: Add #import directives for Objective-C when header insertion is enabled.

limit_references.description: Maximum number of references returned (0 = no limit).

limit_results.description: Maximum number of results returned (0 = no limit).

log.description: Log verbosity: error, info, or verbose.

offset_encoding.description: Override offset encoding: utf-8, utf-16, or utf-32 (empty = auto-negotiate).

pch_storage.description: PCH storage location: memory or disk.

pretty.description: Pretty-print JSON output (for --check mode or stdin).

query_driver.description: Comma-separated list of glob patterns for whitelisting gcc-compatible drivers to extract system includes.

remote_index_address.description: Address of the remote index server (e.g., http://localhost:1234).

rename_file_limit.description: Maximum files affected by symbol renaming (0 = no limit).

threads.description: Number of async workers (0 = auto-detect). Corresponds to -j flag.
